title: Replay from any point: the journal folds from the middle, honestly — replay_from folds the suffix seq >= N from zero at that point; bounds are honest (0..max seq, empty journal exposes only 0, out-of-bounds raises ValueError, never silent clamping); density is required (a gapped journal is an integrity failure, not a state to fold); every monotone counter of the suffix fold equals the whole-run counter minus the prefix counter, and the module never claims additivity where it is false (runs_open is clamped, last_reply/final_stop describe only their own window); a torn tail is invisible to the fold and reported, never folded; from 0 is the whole run and from max seq folds exactly one event; the state is the view and the view renders through the redaction engine — a raw token on disk never leaves it even inside last_reply; the render names its window, is byte-deterministic with no wall-clock; the CLI exits 0 folded / 1 missing journal / 2 bad bounds with redacted stdout
task_text: produce a journal worth replaying from the middle
